reply_text:
I replied to Pree in our DM. I said the possible 165-seat change for Quarrendon's Amendment No. 1 stays there: I won't post it anywhere, mention it to anyone else, or save it to GBrain or any other shared notes. If it gets confirmed and they want it shared, we'll work out where it should go.

Before replying I searched GBrain for the account. It has an Aug 20, 2025 #north-team message from Dana Okafor saying Amendment No. 1 took Quarrendon to 185 seats (she first typed 180, then corrected it). I left that out of my reply to Pree. I haven't checked that they're in #north-team, and the rumour didn't need an answer.
